identification: Five piece engine-turned silver-backed dressing set in a fitted black case: hand mirror, two oval hair brushes, two clothes brushes, scroll monogram on mirror. Hallmark close-up (photo 3) shows a maker's punch (S&L-like, uncertain) and a small date letter; Birmingham c.1920s per cloud scan, I could not confirm the town mark. Backs look dented and wavy (thin silver over filler).
